tagline: Some people have comfort shows. I have comfort TED talks.

why_i_watch.Psychology: I want to know why people do what they do: why we feel what we feel, choose what we choose, and keep coming back. One innocent question can become a 45-minute investigation, and these talks are where it usually starts.
why_i_watch.Learning: I started Girls Who Code chapters at two middle schools and grew them to 240+ girls. Ever since, I’ve been hooked on how people learn, and what makes learning actually stick.
why_i_watch.Creativity: I’m happiest taking something from “wait, what if…” to something you can actually see, use, or experience. These talks are about exactly that.
why_i_watch.Becoming: I’d rather temporarily suck at something interesting than only do things I already know how to do. These are the talks I go back to when being a beginner feels hard.
why_i_watch.Life & People: I care about my relationships more than almost anything. These talks ask what actually makes a life good, and the answer keeps coming back to people.
why_i_watch.Ideas & Brands: I want to know why some ideas become companies people can’t stop talking about. These are the founders who built them and the thinkers who explain why we buy, choose, trust and come back.
